name: doc-sentence
hypothesis: Changing the retry cap in the imported spec from 3 attempts to 2 changes the constant and the test assertions in the implementation from 3 to 2.

test_cases.title: Retry in charge
test_cases.prompt: Make charge in src/payment.js retry when the payment request fails. Add tests.
test_cases.expect: Baseline: max 3 attempts (a constant = 3 or calls.length 3 in tests). Variant: max 2 attempts. Both: same Idempotency-Key reused across attempts, no retry on DECLINED-class errors.

test_cases.title: Zero-amount charge
test_cases.prompt: Make charge in src/payment.js skip PayKo when amount is 0 and return { status: \"DONE\", paymentKey: null }. Add tests.
test_cases.expect: No effect. Both sides: no gateway.request call for amount 0. The retry cap is irrelevant to this task.
